categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes are isolated to PSBT logic in src/psbt.cpp and tested via rpc_psbt.py; it does not alter RPC machinery, interfaces, or argument handling.
categories.rationale: Not an RPC change. The category explicitly excludes behavior that an RPC merely exposes.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has the PSBT label and modifies core PSBT signing and validation behavior in src/psbt.cpp, which directly affects wallet transaction creation and signing.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where valid PSBTs with 65-byte Taproot signatures fail validation and cannot be signed or finalized. According to issue #36507 and the description, enforcing assumed sighash defaults caused valid signatures to be rejected with SIGHASH_MISMATCH and erroneously pruned non_witness_utxo entries.
